metadata.description: Repository BenchmarkList migration and quality-gate coverage

models/molmo2.md.reason: The verified aggregate record has no metric definitions; retain the primary Ai2 paper until BenchmarkList exposes typed metrics.

multimodal/local-audio-language-models.m.reason: The MMAU record has no verified review state; retain peer-reviewed primary sources.

rag/embedding-models.md.reason: MTEB remains authoritative; BenchmarkList lacks the complete current suite aggregates used by this article.

multimodal/facial-recognition-deepfake-i.reason: NIST FRTE/FATE and primary detection papers provide stronger coverage than the available BenchmarkList records.

evaluation/ai-observability.md.reason: The article covers evaluation infrastructure rather than comparative model benchmark results.

agents/agentic-harnesses.md.reason: Framework survey; benchmark mentions are contextual rather than result rankings.

agents/frameworks-research-agents.md.reason: Research-agent evaluations need a dedicated harness and benchmark identity review.

agents/grounded-search-for-llms.md.reason: Search-agent benchmark coverage needs a dedicated provenance pass.

agents/mcp-alternatives-and-tool-calling.reason: Protocol survey; benchmark mentions do not form comparative result tables.

evaluation/chatbot-topic-hijacking-preve.reason: Safety benchmark coverage needs task- and attack-version mapping.

media-generation/deepfake-creation-model.reason: Threat and accessibility survey; no central comparative benchmark ranking.

media-generation/local-image-generation-.reason: Image-generation arenas and objective metrics require separate scale handling.

models/current-best-frontier-llms.md.reason: Its BenchmarkList provenance is shared with models/frontier-models-benchmark.md.

models/turboquant-mac-qwen3-5.md.reason: Systems-performance claims are better supported by the TurboQuant paper and implementation measurements.

multimodal/real-time-voice-llms.md.reason: Voice quality, latency, and tool-use metrics require separate benchmark families.

rag/embedding-pre-screening-chatbot-topi.reason: Design guidance rather than a current model leaderboard.

rag/large-document-llm-methods.md.reason: Method survey; benchmark mentions are supporting evidence rather than rankings.

rag/rag-and-context-engineering.md.reason: Architecture survey; comparative benchmark claims are not central.

rag/turbovec-vector-quantization.md.reason: Performance claims must remain tied to the turbovec and TurboQuant implementations.
